scope: Four still PNG keyframes only; no full animation, playback or production acceptance

checks.name: Original identity and static regions
checks.note: Head, face, hair, headset, torso centre and boots remain original after pixel protection; this does not approve the unprotected generated source images.

checks.name: Skin opacity
checks.note: Selected palms have opaque peach interiors on both backgrounds; numeric translucent-skin ratios are under 5%. This is not a guarantee for later optical-flow frames.

checks.name: Canvas and feet
checks.note: 768 square, shared registration, 20% margins and original feet preserved.

checks.name: Shoulder and sleeve connection
checks.note: Prep sleeve contour and gold stripe meet the preserved collar with an abrupt break; peak sleeve stripe connection also remains visually awkward at close range. Enlarging and feathering the mask reduced the detached appearance but did not meet the strict art gate.

checks.name: Motion readiness
checks.note: Only three new poses exist. Hand-opening transitions and the gesture at the peak still need intermediate key poses before interpolation. No 15 fps animation or browser playback was reviewed.

requiredNextSteps: Correct prep and peak shoulder contours without changing the original face or feet.
Add an intermediate opening-palm pose to reduce fist-to-open-hand changes.
Review revised PNGs on light and dark backgrounds; bind a new art hash.
